description: Legacy COBOL modernisation consulting for banking/financial systems
problem: Banks run 220B+ lines of COBOL code. Modernisation is high-risk, expensive, and slow. Traditional approaches cost $50M-$500M per bank and take 3-7 years.
solution: AI-assisted COBOL-to-modern-stack migration with cryptographic audit trails. Every migration step is Ed25519-signed, creating an immutable record of what changed.

risk_categories.mitigation: Signed snapshots at every migration step, rollback capability
Parallel-run strategy, gradual cutover, instant rollback
Signed audit trail, regulator-approved migration log
API contract testing, signed integration proofs
Open standards, MCP-native, no proprietary runtime

target_market: Tier 1 banks (JPMorgan, HSBC, Barclays, Deutsche Bank)
Tier 2 banks with legacy COBOL core
Insurance companies with COBOL policy systems
Government agencies with COBOL benefits systems
Payment processors with COBOL settlement systems
competitive_advantage: Signed audit trail — regulator-ready migration evidence
AI-assisted code analysis — faster, cheaper than manual
MCP-native — integrates with existing AI agent infrastructure
Open source tools — no vendor lock-in
status: FRAMEWORK — product definition complete, need pilot customer
